descriptions.zh:
本接口目前适用于固定拉流。调用本接口可以删除固定拉流的配置信息。


## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为30次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation supports deleting only the configurations of scheduled stream pulling.

## QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 30 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-live-pull-stream-info-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DeleteLivePullStreamInfoConfig --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName liveStream0000 --DomainName 'example.com' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AppName liveApp0000
